project_type: pnpm 10 TypeScript monorepo: packages/core (pure TS decoder), packages/decoder (/api/decode), packages/web (Next.js 15.1.12 App Router, React 19; the website at / and the app at /app), packages/eval
build_system: pnpm workspace (packageManager pnpm@10.28.0), Node 22+. Tokens: design/system/tokens.json -> `pnpm -F @ninth/web tokens` regenerates packages/web/styles/tokens.css (committed, compared by test/tokens.test.ts). tsconfig.base.json sets noUncheckedIndexedAccess: true, so indexing an array with a number gives T | undefined: use tuples indexed by literal unions, or map.
test_framework: Vitest 2.1 + Testing Library (jsdom) in packages/web/test/*.test.ts(x); Playwright 1.63 Node scripts in packages/web/test/e2e/*.mjs against a running server
test_command: pnpm -F @ninth/web test --run > /tmp/nl-web.log 2>&1; echo exit $? >> /tmp/nl-web.log   (then read the file; one file: from packages/web `npx vitest run test/<file> > /tmp/nl-one.log 2>&1`)
verification_instructions: 1) `pnpm -r typecheck` exits 0. 2) Web unit tests: at baseline 335 of 336 pass; the only failure is site.test.tsx 'MS-4.1 the page shows the copy of content.md' because content.md already holds the round-2 copy; it must pass from plan step 11 on, and no other test may fail after any step. 3) `node scripts/tm-lint.mjs <changed files>` exits 0. 4) E2E (plan steps 13 and 15 only): confirm `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3000/` and `/app` are 200, else pause with send_message severity 'warning' and ask; then from packages/web `BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 node test/e2e/site.mjs` (and axe, keyboard, switch, spell, responsive; ENGINE=webkit for site and responsive). 5) `node scripts/validate-kiro-config.mjs` and `node scripts/check-kiro-not-ignored.mjs` when .kiro files change.
snapshot_or_generated_files: packages/web/styles/tokens.css is generated from design/system/tokens.json by `pnpm -F @ninth/web tokens` and must equal the generator output (tokens.test.ts). Never hand-edit data/ lexicon JSON.
environment_constraints: Single checkout on main at /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life, round-1 landing page uncommitted in the tree: build on it. NO commit and NO push (user instruction; tech.md rule 3). Never run `next build`, `pnpm build` or `pnpm -F @ninth/web build` while the dev server runs (build-guard hook); never restart the dev server on :3000. Never open or print .env* files. No formatter (no Prettier/ESLint config; never reformat a file). Git hangs without the flags: use `git --no-optional-locks -c core.fsmonitor=false status` / `diff`. Commands that stream long output into the agent shell (vitest in the foreground, git status) hung during planning: redirect output to a file in /tmp and read it, or use run_in_background. `timeout` is not installed (macOS).
contribution_requirements: Spec first: every user-facing behaviour has an MS requirement and a test whose name starts with its ID (.kiro/specs/marketing-site/requirements.md, tasks.md rows 30-44 list the names). Tick each task row in .kiro/specs/marketing-site/tasks.md when done. Copy comes word for word from .kiro/specs/marketing-site/content.md (already updated). Banned claims (product.md) and tm-lint words (trademarks.md) never appear; the intended-purpose sentence stays verbatim. Tokens only (no raw colours, durations or easings in CSS; every duration/delay/easing in a motion declaration is a var(--motion-*) token; no unit literals like 0ms anywhere in site.css). Only KeypadDemo.tsx and SiteMotion.tsx are client components (MS-11.3). Log the work in docs/KIRO_LOG.md with `node scripts/kiro-log.mjs add --who ... --surface "Kiro, workflow" --feature "Spec" --prompt ... --outcome ... --link ...` (credits blank).
key_patterns: Drawings are server components built from nl- classes, tokens and components/Icon.tsx, aria-hidden, nothing focusable, drawn buttons are div.nl-btn.nl-btn--secondary.site-drawn-btn (never nl-btn--primary: MS-1.6 allows exactly 2 primaries on the page). Key size only inline from KeypadPicture.tsx constants (--nl-key); site.css must never contain --nl-key. Round-2 motion model (design.md 3.2): role classes site-in/rise/out/during/ring/mark plus step classes site-k0..k12/site-u0..u13 produced only by pictures/roles.ts helpers; the base styles show the finished state; every animation rule lives inside `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)` under `[data-site-motion="on"]`, drawing play rules use fill `backwards` only; A1/A2/A4 keep `both`. Drawing roots: data-play + one site-play--frame|quick|sweep|type class; SiteMotion sets data-played="instant"|"1". The desktop How picture is NOT a data-play root; .site-how gets data-how-step/-live/-play. Parts that replace each other share a .site-cell grid cell; rings/marks/boxes are absolute overlays. Class names must not contain 'phone', 'handset' or 'device' (site.test MS-4.3). No new data-reveal marks (MS-8.4 counts: how 5, proof 3, conversation 5, access 7, privacy 5); stages never carry data-reveal. In site-motion tests, FakeObserver's lastObserver() must remain the reveal observer: create the play and step observers before it and only when their targets exist. Build-time data (site-data.ts) throws when an example stops being true (pattern: getProofExample).
directory_structure: packages/web/components/site/ holds the website: sections/*.tsx (one per page section), Pictures.tsx (drawings; round 2 adds pictures/HowScreen.tsx, pictures/Conversation.tsx, pictures/Access.tsx, pictures/Privacy.tsx, pictures/roles.ts), KeypadPicture.tsx (the drawn keypad and key sizes), site-data.ts (build-time data, server only), motion.ts (pure helpers), SiteMotion.tsx (client, observers), site.css (all website styles; the motion block is one `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)`; the short-landscape block must stay last). packages/web/test/ holds the unit tests; test/e2e/ the Playwright scripts. design/system/ is the visual source of truth. .kiro/specs/marketing-site/ is the spec.
